# H&G International Group LLC

> H&G International Group LLC is a technology-enabled private equity and hedge fund investment firm based in Las Vegas, Nevada, United States.

## About
H&G International Group LLC invests in live entertainment, sports, hospitality and gaming, including stadium and commercial mixed-use development. The firm takes principal positions, builds patiently, and partners for the long term. Investment decisions are made in-house.

## Technology
The firm operates a proprietary intelligence platform: AI-driven deal sourcing and screening, proprietary underwriting models run against live market data, and real-time portfolio analytics across its hospitality, gaming, sports, and entertainment assets.

## Investment focus
- Live Entertainment
- Sports
- Hospitality
- Gaming
- Stadiums
- Commercial Mixed-Use Development

## In development
- Fly In Fly Out: a private aviation resort and hangar development in Las Vegas, Nevada.
